name: Matarou
source:
A student in the same school as Mikoto, as well as her fellow club member. He confesses his love to Mikoto, becoming her boyfriend.
[spoiler]One day when visiting her and waiting for dinner, he discovers a trail of diary scraps. Learning about her past, her relationship with her parents, and her relationship with Yukimaru.[/spoiler]
